name: Confirming a booking updates all three derived views together

statusDetails.message: POST demo/bookings confirmed booking-2 for apartment 12 Tuesday 17:00–18:30 in ph8. GET views showed that same booking in the posted list, heater schedule and billing signal naming payer 12. Follow-up POST give-up and GET views showed all three cleared for the same booking.

labels.name: story
labels.value: One booking is the single source of truth for the list, the timer and the billing

steps.name: Given: Given Tuesday at 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 is free
When: When the household in apartment 12's standing slot request for Tuesday at 17:00 in pukuhuone 8 is confirmed
Then: Then the posted slot list shows the slot for apartment 12
Then: And the heater schedule heats pukuhuone 8's sauna for Tuesday 17:00 to 18:30
Then: And an invoicing signal is raised naming apartment 12 as payer for the standing slot
